conventions.gender_order: title > description > seller category; never source file
conventions.unisex: unisex label if it exists, else 'khác'

pandas3_regex: With pandas>=3, CSV text columns use RE2, where \b is ASCII-only; r'\bnữ\b' fails on the category column. v3 sets python_regex; 112 snapshot rows change. v2 uses (?:^|\W) on categories and is essentially unaffected.

post_holdout_experiments.text_classifier_hybrid: TF-IDF + LinearSVC trained on 35,866 v3 name-rule rows plus confirmed development labels, 5-fold CV on 1,042 development rows: best hybrid 86.8% versus 86.5% rules only. Not adopted.
post_holdout_experiments.rule_error_review: Remaining development errors are dispersed (at most 2 per confusion pair); no further systematic rule fix found.

random_300_gate.design: simple random sample of 300, seed 20261125, excluding 1,343 previously labelled IDs; blind contributor labels
random_300_gate.note: Point estimate passes; the 95% interval still includes values below 85%.

quality_acceptance_basis: Team decision 2026-11-25: the 85% gate is measured on a corpus-representative random sample; the stratified holdout (74.3%) is reported as a stress test.
